scope: Fourteen complete May MIDP2 RU native/raw/optimized packet-queue, SOCKS-send, roster-packing/event, connect/retry/event, MIDlet timer/splash/workscreen and error-description methods. Only typed names are normalized; every instruction, local, branch, handler, descriptor and access flag stays explicit. Raw instance methods that become static stay documented, including receiver loads passed to raw helpers. Differing bodies are not declared equal. This inventory makes no additional network/thread/runtime or whole-program equivalence claim; the changed resolver has separate three-platform external-capture runtime evidence in source-resolver.json.
